rationale: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=214, naf_encoding=hash, naf_hash_levels=24, naf_hash_feat_dim=4, naf_hash_log2_size=19, naf_hash_base_res=16, naf_hash_max_res=512, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=32, naf_layers=3, naf_n_iter=3000, naf_lr=0.02, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-9 (search-20260619-01, naf). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, not CT pixels). (1) TRAJECTORY + mapped hash params (all hr=0): iter-1 fourier hidden=128 layers=4 lr=1e-2 -> SSIM 0.4729. iter-2 hidden 128->64 -> 0.4943. iter-3 layers 4->3 -> 0.5452. iter-4 lr 1e-2->2e-2 -> 0.5629 = BEST FOURIER. iter-5 lr 2e-2->4e-2 -> 0.3592 REGRESSED. iter-6 audit-fix (A) naf_encoding fourier->hash (Instant-NGP 16-level multi-res hash grid: levels=16 feat_dim=2 log2_size=19 base_res=16 max_res=512 -> 32-dim feature -> SMALL MLP hidden=32 layers=3 lr=2e-2) -> SSIM 0.6715 (PSNR 23.35, params 16.78M) = NEW BEST, hr 0. iter-7 naf_hidden 32->64 (MLP width) -> SSIM 0.6346 FLAT/REGRESSED = MLP-width axis EXHAUSTED. iter-8 naf_hash_feat_dim 2->4 (per-level features, 16x4=64-dim feature) -> SSIM 0.6951 (PSNR 23.37, RMSE 0.003392, params 33.56M, elapsed 1098.4s) = NEW BEST (+0.0236, hr 0) -> richer HASH-FEATURE capacity (not MLP width) is the live SSIM lever. MAPPED hash params so far: feat_dim (2->4, lift) + MLP-width (32<->64, exhausted) probed; hash_levels=16, log2_size=19, base_res=16, max_res=512 still UNTRIED. (2) LIMITER: NAF is REGIME-BOUNDED on DENSE 2304-view Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete -> hr stays 0; audit says the hash fix makes the impl FAITHFUL, real payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks). For SSIM within budget the binding limiter is HASH CAPACITY: iter-8 proved doubling per-level features lifts SSIM, so the multi-res hash grid is still capacity-bound, not decoder-bound. (3) ONE KNOB: naf_hash_levels 16->24 (from iter-8 BEST cfg: naf_encoding=hash, naf_hash_feat_dim=4, naf_hidden=32, naf_layers=3, naf_lr=2e-2, naf_hash_log2_size=19, naf_hash_base_res=16, naf_hash_max_res=512 ALL UNCHANGED; step count / wall UNTOUCHED = the deferred B-fix). hash_levels 16->24 adds 8 more geometric resolution levels between base_res=16 and max_res=512, concatenating 8 more per-level 4-dim features -> input feature 16x4=64-dim -> 24x4=96-dim. This is the natural next hash-capacity axis after feat_dim (iter-8 lifted along the feature axis; levels lifts along the resolution axis), the most direct test of whether richer hash capacity KEEPS lifting SSIM. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if naf_hash_levels 16->24, SSIM rises above 0.6951 because more multi-res levels give the hash grid finer resolution coverage and a richer feature for the INR within the same per-scene step budget. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.6951, hash capacity is EXHAUSTED in-budget on dense Mayo -- the hash-NAF ceiling here is ~0.70 SSIM (well below LD-FBP ~0.81 cal floor, hr 0), a STRUCTURAL NEGATIVE on dense 2304-view Mayo (regime-bounded; real payoff is the SPARSE benchmarks), document toward iter-20. (5) SIZE to HARD 1200s budget: 214-scene pass, naf_outer_wall_s=1080 (18-min in-solver outer wall = governor) + naf_per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall; naf_n_iter=3000 stays a HIGH CAP so the WALL governs). STEP COUNT KEPT at iter-6/8 value (per_scene_s 5.0, n_iter cap 3000 UNCHANGED -- raising it is the DEFERRED B-fix; NOT touched). 214x5.0s=1070s ~= 1080s outer wall (measured elapsed 1098.4s at iter-8 feat_dim=4, inside the 30-min sbatch kill). hash_levels 16->24 adds 8 small per-level hash-table gathers/step + grows the MLP input 64->96-dim (one extra Linear(96,32) row block); per-step cost stays DOMINATED by the fixed 2304-view fan-beam forward+backward, so step count per 5.0s scene stays comparable -- ~free on the wall, fits the HARD 1200s budget. val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices), staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (inlined single-val-ps probe -> L277 native ps ~0.73979), bg_target=truth, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override), naf_encoding=hash kept. (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.
